_note: Calibrated from the first fully-green run (2026-08-04, 143 checks / 0 failures, 50.3 min) at GRAND_OFFERS=25 with the batcher at 7 slots. Enforcement is baseline x 1.2. Re-calibrate for a different scale or a different box: these are wall-clock numbers and publishToIndexed is dominated by the celestia delayMs, not by node work. sseDeliveryLagP95Ms was recalibrated (66 -> 2674) when archived_at became chain-derived: the metric compares SSE arrival (wall clock) against archived_at, so it now measures block-timestamp -> client delivery INCLUDING STM executor lag (~1.5-2.5s on dev), not pure socket delivery. The old 66ms number was only possible because archived_at used to BE wall-clock NOW() — the bug. bookReadP95Ms raised 10 -> 20: with count=10 the p95 is effectively the max single read, and a lone 19ms read (p50 unmoved at 7-8ms) tripped the x1.2 gate on the 0.103.1 verification run. A real read-path regression moves the median, not one sample.
